_: What scripts/sbom cannot read off the resolved build: the license each component is
under, and the code vendored inside a package that no manifest declares. Everything
else in the SBOM - identity, URL, version, revision - is read, never written here.
A package in Package.resolved with no entry here fails the build by name, and so
does an entry here for a package Package.resolved no longer pins.
`licenseFile` is read from the package's checkout and its digest recorded, so the
SBOM says which text the license id stands for, and the text itself is carried in it
for the notices the app ships. `licenseMatch`, where given, is a regular expression
whose first group is the license's part of a file that holds more than its license. A
model's `licenseFile` is in this repository, since Hugging Face repos ship none. A
vendored component's `version` names the file to read it from and a regular expression
